label: First input is d/z/f (weak), or the 2nd copy step of a length-3 sequence (strong)
explanation: Two disjoint components. (1) At t=0 when the first original token is d, z or f: about 10% of t=0 steps, but weak (about 0.04-0.07 of max) and about 37% of activation mass. (2) In length-3 sequences only, at t=4, the second copy step (recall_idx=1, input = the echoed orig(0), one output left). This fires on essentially every L=3 sequence, gives all of the strongest activations (up to max), and carries about 63% of mass. Magnitude here varies with token identity but no simple rule was checked. Never active at t=1..3, at the delimiter, at any other copy step, or at t=4 when L>3. Dev F1 is about 1.0 with a single false positive.
